findings.description: send_campaign only catches RecipientRefused. Any other exception from mailer.send (for example a transient SMTP connection error or timeout) propagates out of the loop. The caller then gets no CampaignReport, so it cannot tell which subscribers already received the campaign. A retry would resend to those subscribers, and the remaining subscribers are silently skipped.
findings.suggestion: Catch the transient mailer error types per recipient and record them in the report (or re-raise with the partial report attached), so that a single failure does not discard the results of earlier sends.
findings.title: Non-refusal send errors abort the whole campaign and discard the report
